description: Source code for CUDA GDS file operations including load, save, register, and deregister buffers and handles, with pybind11 bindings.

methods.name: gds_load_storage
methods.description: Reads data from a CUDA file handle into storage at a specified offset.

methods.name: gds_save_storage
methods.description: Writes data from storage to a CUDA file handle at a specified offset.

methods.name: gds_register_buffer
methods.description: Registers a storage buffer with cuFile.

methods.name: gds_deregister_buffer
methods.description: Deregisters a storage buffer from cuFile.

methods.name: gds_register_handle
methods.description: Registers a file descriptor as a cuFile handle and returns its handle as int64.

methods.name: gds_deregister_handle
methods.description: Deregisters a cuFile handle given as int64.

methods.name: initGdsBindings
methods.description: Initializes Python bindings for GDS functions if USE_CUFILE is defined.
